'''Mahiro Shukosa''' is [[Warder]] to [[Rafela Cindal]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mahiro Shukosa}} He was a [[Kandori]] lord. He enjoys gambling, reciting poetry, playing the harp, and dancing.

== Appearance ==
He is handsome and is graying temples. He has a noble nose. He uses two swords that he carries on his back.

== Activities ==
He is very friendly with [[Min Farshaw]] and thinks of her as a younger sister. He warns her not to poke her nose to deeply in [[Aes Sedai]] affairs.
